protocol.authority: Human renewed autonomous research and waived routine experiment approvals on 2026-10-21; executes the previously specified separate 2 CPU-hour study without another confirmation.
protocol.budget_rules: Probe pays n*(h+Q) messages and n environment units; it is discarded for training. Each action uses M=min(floor(remaining_messages/(h+q)),floor(remaining_clock/b)), pays all M blocks including final D withheld. Catalogue is stop plus every original (q,b) action, with original deterministic learner and step rule. Stop consumes no training resources. No padding or matched-realized-cost claim.
protocol.feasibility: Original fixed probe: smallest n<=4096 with affinity<=.025. New probe policies always use a feasible paid probe, without outcome-based admission; infeasible cases use the original full-budget all-agent fallback. Legacy policies preserve their original decisions and do not gain an optimized stop option. New catalogue optimizers and strongest fixed comparators include stop.
protocol.information: A known-zero paid pilot observes the same latent common-noise state as future training. Public rules see this centered calibration signal, both hypothetical covariance laws, radius1 and budgets; never the realized regime, hidden target, error sign, future noise or scientific outcomes. Known-error and known-regime policies are evaluation-only.
protocol.initialization: Actual learner parameter0, hidden target=-e; e in {-1,+1}. Scalar error evolution is evaluated by its independently checked exact linear weights. Affine observations have target contribution mu*target, with mu=.5. Both signs share the same potential noise stream.
protocol.negative_preservation: All128 designs,256 regime strata,both signs,all9policies and all costs retained. Oracle-only gains cannot establish deployable benefit. Null or negative stops this avenue without automatic tuning/retry.
protocol.predata_registration: Sources, runtime, historical seeds, proposal and protocol committed/pushed before any formal trajectory; data root created exactly once by supervisor.
protocol.primary: Per independent master seed: average each normalized paired loss improvement equally across128 public family/learner/budget designs, both regimes and both hidden error signs. Normalize by the exact pre-data population risk of the best balanced full-budget fixed program including stop. Two contrasts: best balanced fixed minus robust conditional; posterior-marginal minus robust conditional. Both one-sided99.5% bootstrap lower limits>0 AND mean fixed contrast>=.01 are required for positive mechanism decision; bootstrap coverage is approximate.
protocol.profile: First complete learner/seed part and its replay are retained as formal science/replay prefixes. Project charge_used+1.5*127*(measured first science part plus its replay)+900<=7200. Setup/profile charge must<=300. No scientific outcome inspected for admission.
protocol.scope: Known binary Gaussian noise and observable calibration pilot, fixed linear learners, fixed public regime prior; no general MARL, unknown-model calibration or automatic TSP admission.
